method: Main read both companies' current rendered pages in Chrome and the product pages through the web reader

developer.name: walkingtoyou GmbH
developer.finding: Own About page, visibly updated 13 October 2026, explicitly attributes in-house database development to walkingtoyou. Its blue.project product is licensed separately from the hosted offering. This is an original maintained software product, not merely generic FileMaker support.
developer.identity: Do not rename walkingtoweb or merge the two companies merely because they share an address and contact person
developer.socials: About page links a personal founder LinkedIn profile, not a corporate profile; do not import it as the company account

host.finding: Current About page describes operation of vendor-based infrastructure and separately identifies walkingtoyou as the FileMaker developer. The English blue.project hosting page explicitly credits development to walkingtoyou; the developer's current product page identifies walkingtoweb as its hosting partner.
host.recommendation: Exclude the hosting-only map listing under the original-technology criterion, while preserving the organisation and relationships
host.caveat: Common ownership or the same contact person does not establish which legal company develops the software. No assertion of inactivity, poor engineering or closure.
host.remaining: Central review and action-time approval before irreversible location removal; no removal performed
